newsitem.title: USA: Millennium sees low titanium dioxide profits.
newsitem.headline: Millennium sees low titanium dioxide profits.

text.p: Millennium Chemicals Inc said Friday it expects its average full year titanium dioxide price to be considerable lower than last year's price.
The company said the titanium dioxide profitability will be lower in 1997 than in 1996 before an expected rebound in 1998.
The company said polyethylene sales volume in the first quarter were the same as they were a year ago.
The company reported net sales of polyethylene and related products for the first quarter of $359 million versus net sales of $285 million for the same period a year ago.
The company said average polyethylene prices increased 31 percent from the comparable quarter last year.
The company reported net income of or $0.26 per share, compared with pro forma $0.39 per share, for the same period a year ago.
